Name: Fargo Garlic Nutri Pickle 200 gm
LongDescription: Fargo Garlic Nutri Pickle – A magical combination of ‘Superfood’ Moringa powder, Deshi Garlic, Lychi flower Honey, Ghani extracted Mustard oil, and desi spices. The super yummy pickle is rich in vitamins, antioxidants, calcium, protein, and other essential nutrients. We use only the finest quality ingredients with a blend of aromatic spices such as mustard seeds, cumin, and fennel, which give it a delicious and complex flavor profile. Garlic and Moringa Powder are known to have numerous health benefits. It can help lower blood pressure, improve digestion and gut health, detoxify the body and ensure glowing skin, reduce inflammation, promote heart health, improve cholesterol levels and sexual function, and even boost your immune system.
